column1: # The latest independent audit of each table: an auditor who did not write the entries drew a random sample of rows graded understood
# and re-derived each from the binaries or the cited specification. real = the entry held up, shallow = true but derived from a name or
# credited without behaviour of its own, wrong = contradicted. sample is small: read it with the percentage. The last row of a table with
# the latest date is the one summary.tsv and docs/coverage.md show.

sample of the 206 sample-implementation entries promoted to Established in d6a883a..0c62dae (seed 20261030; 8 so_xform siblings, 6 so_lighting, 6 so_attrib N32, 5 so_stencilop and so_fog siblings, 5 other) read against the shipped body and the public body; the four shallow are three begin-mode entry checks (PushMatrix, PopMatrix in the 64-bit and original 32-bit builds) that omit the validate-pending branch and a light-model colour-control test that truncates the float where the public body compares it; census of all 43 entries carrying the "not compared with the public macros" hedge found nine with the validate branch (Push, Pop, LoadIdentity in three builds), the other 34 corrected to state the in-begin error test; no so_clip, so_depthop or so_capi entry was promoted

sample of the 154 so_eval.c (140) and so_image.c (14) sample-implementation entries promoted to Established in 2b17400..d1caf1e (seed 20261030; 8 N32, 6 64-bit, 6 original 32-bit so_eval, 5 so_image) read against the shipped body and the public body, with callees resolved through the GOT and the default evaluator table checked in the binary; the four wrong are three original 32-bit entries (Map2d, EvalCoord1f, EvalCoord1fv) that say the public evaluator-call macro is not defined in the public tree when apimacro.h defines it empty (the same sentence was in all 20 original 32-bit evaluator-API entries, and the 32 N32 and 64-bit entries said only "no code at the site", now reworded) and the N32 DoEvalCoord1 entry, whose "3 indirect calls" is 5 (six such counts corrected by counting jalr sites); begin-mode, validate and colour-changed handling was present in every sampled entry; the original 32-bit heading has no entry for four routines the other builds have (DoEvalCoord2, PreEvaluate, ComputeNormal2, sendChange)

sample of the 223 sample-implementation entries promoted to Established in 6b5144d..8a724f1 (so_napi 20, so_vapi 72, so_tapi 83, so_finish 4, so_rect 18, so_select 16, mips_fastapi 8, mips_zfuncs 2; seed 20261030; 8 vapi, 6 tapi, 4 napi, 7 sibling) read against the shipped body and the public body; the three wrong are original 32-bit Vertex4f, Vertex2iv and Vertex4iv, which say the dispatch pointer is advanced by 1320 in the call delay slot where the add is two instructions earlier and the delay slot is the last array store (20 of the 21 original 32-bit vertex-array entries said so, all corrected; Vertex2f is the one where it is true); the four shallow are N32 Normal3d, Normal3b, Normal3sv and 64-bit Normal3dv, which say only that loads, scaling and stores match the public body with no offsets or constants (all 20 so_napi entries now state the context pointer word, the x/y/z offsets and the scale words, read from all 20 bodies); texture-coordinate, rect, select and fast-path entries held, with offsets, error codes and call order checked against the bodies

sample of the 30 so_names.c sample-implementation entries promoted to Established in ba8dbfb, 6ed8d02, 200b3d8 and d96331d (all N32; seed 20261030 over the 30 entries still labelled Established; 33 entries were rewritten in those commits, three of them left Inferred) read against the shipped body and the public body; the three shallow are N32 nextLeaf (listed a third-child test the body does not have, since a child that is neither first nor second is simply treated as the third), __glNamesUnlockDataList (said the free hook takes the count; it takes the item pointer, the address of its count word) and __glNamesDeleteNames (said the peeled first name is not compared; the body compares it with itself in a never-taken branch with an unreachable zero-length release); all other sampled entries held, with child offsets, field offsets, allocation sizes, spare-record counts, unrolled loops and the splitParent compare-swap order checked against the bodies; the 64-bit and original 32-bit siblings of the three are still Inferred and claim nothing

sample of the 72 sample-implementation entries promoted to Established in e1da8df..c4354fb (so_attrib 12, dl_table 4, so_blend 3, so_buffers 2, so_depthop 2, so_polymode 1, so_store 2, so_listcomp 8, so_capi 6, so_dlist 4, so_math and so_size 18, so_pick 10; seed 20261030; 12 64-bit, 8 original 32-bit, none N32 by chance) read against the shipped body and the public body, with GOT callees resolved by address; the one shallow is original 32-bit LineWidth, whose first helper takes only the width in the float argument register and never gets the context where the public rounding call passes both, and the entry said calls matched (the 64-bit sibling said the rounding helper was called with the context and the width, which is false, and the N32 entry said calls matched; all three corrected, the helper bodies were already described correctly in the N32 and 64-bit RoundWidth entries); begin-mode, validate and dirty handling was stated in every sampled entry that has it; the null list-execution and size-wrapper entries held
